images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. A hard-sci-fi orbital puzzle game in a mission-control HUD style: the curved limb of Earth fills the lower half, night side on the left sprinkled with city lights, day side on the right with blue ocean, cloud streaks and a bright atmospheric rim, the Sun flaring at the right edge. Six thin cyan elliptical orbit lines with integer sector tick marks arc over the planet; tiny debris fragments glint like stars and small satellites with solar panels carry labels. Upper right, a spent rocket stage is bracketed by a cyan targeting reticle with a label 'D-117 폐기 로켓 상단', an orange tug thrusting beside it and an amber 'Δv' arrow. A dashed amber predicted transfer path descends to a lower orbit and meets a pulsing red ring with a warning box '교차 예측 T+14 · 충돌 확률 31%'. Panels with angled corners: fuel '38.6 kg', a polar integer grid minimap, operator request queue '운영사 요청', a tick timeline, buttons '밀기 실행'. Top bar title '궤도 청소부'. Deep black space, cyan and amber UI, faint scanlines. Correction: all satellites and operators use fictional codes only (e.g. 'HAN-22', 'ORB-5', '운영사 누리', '운영사 청람'); no real satellite, agency or company names (no KOMPSAT, Starlink, SpaceX, JAXA, NASA) and no calendar date or year — the clock shows only mission time 'T+0'.

Earth's limb below is tinted red, the screen edges pulse crimson. Center top: a red-and-black hazard-striped banner '경보 · 경보 · 경보' above a huge glowing headline '케슬러 연쇄' and a caption. Left panel: a huge red counter '파편 수 9,870'. Right panel: a branching tree chart '충돌 연쇄 · 세대별' growing 1, 2, 5, 13, 34. Bottom-left damage panel '피해' listing destroyed satellites and '사용 불가 궤도 42년'. Bottom-right red buttons '구역 봉쇄' and '처음부터'. Alarm mood, black and crimson with hot orange sparks, scanlines and grain.
